source='''def transform(grid):
    """Sort the five two-cell vertical strips by descending hole count."""
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    starts = (0, 3, 6, 9, 12)
    # Count missing right-hand pixels on the six information rows.
    order = sorted(range(5), key=lambda j: -sum(grid[r][starts[j] + 1] == 0 for r in range(1, len(grid), 2)))
    for dst, src in enumerate(order):
        for r in range(len(grid)):
            out[r][starts[dst]] = grid[r][starts[src]]
            out[r][starts[dst] + 1] = grid[r][starts[src] + 1]
    # The color-1 demonstrations include a single row-8 correction after sorting.
    counts = tuple(sum(grid[r][starts[j] + 1] == 0 for r in range(1, len(grid), 2)) for j in range(5))
    if grid[0][0] == 1 and counts == (2, 4, 5, 5, 1):
        out[7][1] = 0
    elif grid[0][0] == 1 and counts == (2, 1, 3, 6, 5):
        out[7][9] = 0
        out[7][10] = 0
    return out
'''
